channel.title: Code Notes made by Vaibhav Rathod
channel.description: Last 20 notes on Code Notes made by Vaibhav Rathod

item.title: A Search Algorithm
item.description: Comprehensive guide to the A* Search algorithm. Explains the f(n) = g(n) + h(n) evaluation, admissibility, consistency, distance metrics, and complete grid-based pathfinding in Python, C++, JavaScript, Java, and C.

item.title: AA Tree
item.description: AA Tree is a simplified variant of Red-Black Tree. Learn skew, split, insertion, deletion, and search with C++ code examples and complexity analysis.

item.title: ACE (Adaptive Communicative Environment)
item.description: ACE (Adaptive Communication Environment) reference for C++ networked and real-time systems. Covers reactor pattern, proactor, sockets, threading, and service configuration.

item.title: Ableton Live
item.description: Ableton Live reference covering Session and Arrangement views, clips, MIDI, audio effects, instruments, Max for Live, and music production workflows.

item.title: About
item.description: About Free Code Notes — a free, comprehensive programming knowledge base built by VR-Rathod for developers, students, and tech enthusiasts.

item.title: Abstract Classes
item.description: Abstract classes define interfaces with partial implementation. Covers pure virtual functions, abstract base classes, inheritance, and C++ examples.

item.title: Abstraction
item.description: Abstraction hides implementation details and exposes only essential features. Covers data abstraction, procedural abstraction, abstract classes, and C++ examples.

item.title: Ackermann Function
item.description: The Ackermann function is a total computable function that is not primitive recursive. Explore its definition, recursion depth, growth rate, and C++ implementation.

item.title: Adobe After Effects
item.description: After Effects reference covering compositions, keyframes, expressions, effects, masks, 3D layers, rendering, and motion graphics for video production.

item.title: Adobe XD
item.description: Adobe XD complete reference covering artboards, components, auto-animate, prototyping, design systems, plugins, developer handoff, and UI/UX workflows.

item.title: Advanced Graphics
item.description: Comprehensive advanced graphics programming reference covering Vulkan, DirectX 12, Metal, WebGPU, HLSL, GLSL, compute shaders, render graphs, GPU architecture, and modern rendering techniques.

item.title: Affinity Designer
item.description: Affinity Designer reference covering vector and pixel personas, nodes, curves, symbols, grids, export options, and professional illustration workflows.

item.title: Alpine Linux
item.description: Comprehensive Alpine Linux reference covering installation, apk package management, OpenRC, musl libc, BusyBox, Docker containers, security hardening, and embedded/server use cases.

item.title: Altair
item.description: Altair is a declarative statistical visualization library for Python based on Vega-Lite. Covers charts, encodings, transformations, interactive plots, and data.

item.title: Ansible
item.description: Ansible automates IT infrastructure with YAML playbooks. Covers inventory, playbooks, roles, modules, Ansible Vault, AWX, and idempotent configuration.

item.title: Api
item.description: Comprehensive API reference covering REST principles, HTTP methods, status codes, authentication, versioning, GraphQL, OpenAPI specification, and API design.

item.title: Arch Linux
item.description: Comprehensive Arch Linux reference covering installation, pacman, AUR, systemd, kernel management, desktop environments, security hardening, and system maintenance.

item.title: Ardour
item.description: Ardour is an open-source DAW for recording, editing, and mixing. Covers tracks, regions, MIDI, plugins, routing, export, and professional audio workflows.

item.title: Arrays
item.description: Master Arrays in Data Structures & Algorithms. Learn about static vs dynamic arrays, memory contiguity, amortized time complexity, and implement dynamic arrays in multiple languages.

item.title: Arrow
item.description: Arrow provides a sensible, human-friendly approach to dates and times in Python. Covers parsing, formatting, timezones, shifting, humanize, and Arrow vs.
